Destinations cannot influence partition selection. Selected IDs, source coordinates, paired-file/frame provenance and algorithm freeze precede B destination access. V sources and destinations remain evaluator-owned; later US intensities and warps cannot tune model or alignment.

MRI-before-US is a separate baseline alignment input role, not an independent displacement outcome. Its all-pair proper rigid fit and source-only alignment QC freeze precede B or V displacement access.

Case4 remains DEVELOPMENT after the disclosed post-selection published aggregate exposure. Existing cohorts and unopened reserved patients retain their roles; overlapping landmark sets and aliases do not become independent samples.
World millimetres and reported column order do not establish actual anatomical axes or native image/point binding. The contract leaves those unverified until a source-bound header/frame audit.
Original acquisition supplies no accepted brain/cavity boundary. US coverage, nonzero head MRI, landmark-driven mask dilation and invented skull constraints cannot supply one.

The candidate material, traction-free exterior and averaged displacement supports are prospective interpolation assumptions. Sparse conditional displacement cannot validate tool action, retraction, cutting, force, injury or clinical use.
